title: Cohort SLI Playbook: experiment throttles and reliability lead handoff
creator: Asha Patel
description: We need a prescriptive, low-friction playbook that ties SLI cohort targets to experiment throttles and an explicit reliability lead handoff process. The goal is to let product and platform teams run deliberate feature experiments while protecting downstream SLOs and making ownership handoffs (to on-call and platform) clear. This ticket captures the PM-owned checklist, required telemetry changes, and rollout guardrails for the playbook so teams can opt into it without bespoke runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: A single living playbook doc (Confluence) exists with step-by-step actions for PMs, Eng, and On-call leads
Dashboard panels added to Console for cohort-level SLI trends and active experiment throttle status
An automated notification flow (Slack/email) triggers when an experiment consumes >25% of a cohort error budget
A documented handoff template for reliability leads that includes required artifacts (prometheus queries, recent deploys, runbook links)
Two cross-team dry runs completed with platform and one product team and resulting feedback incorporated

notes: Trade-offs discussed: fully automated throttles (fast) vs human-in-the-loop gates (safer). We recommended conservative auto-throttle for P1 SLOs, manual escalation for P0.
Fallback policy: experiments that exhaust >50% of the remaining error budget will get immediate partial rollback path and an on-call page based on SLI type.
Retention: playbook will be reviewed quarterly and after any incident where an experiment contributed >20% of SLI burn.
